scope: Extend the whole-operation AC1032 RENDERSETTINGS ASCII/Binary allocation sweep with Legacy and Modern MentalRay preset layouts and verify rollback, same-codec retry and typed readback.

source.profile: One generated Legacy MentalRay profile with 16 longs, 3 strings, 12 booleans, 7 shorts and 11 doubles, plus one Modern MentalRay profile with 16 longs, 4 strings, 14 booleans, 7 shorts and 11 doubles. No external DWG/DXF fixture is used or added.

implementation.method: Add Legacy and Modern MentalRay profiles to the existing whole-operation transaction mode. Inject one-shot allocation failures at every calibrated offset in ASCII and Binary, checking destination and full caller state, handle-binding rollback and staging cleanup. Retry each failed operation on the same codec and require clean byte identity and typed readback of positional and finalized named fields.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests -j4: PASS; ASan target build: PASS
validation.directRun: PASS; expanded sweep reaches 137 ASCII and 132 Binary allocation offsets; caller/destination rollback, handle-binding rollback, staging cleanup, same-codec retry and typed readback pass.

limitations: Generated transaction evidence for these two AC1032 layouts does not establish producer-authored wire semantics or version-wide interoperability.
Other per-version profiles, source-producer breadth, dictionary dependency closure and native rendering remain unqualified.
No support claim is promoted and no drawing fixture is committed.
